data.rationale: The proposal has the same steps in the same order (special events list in the city, event, ticket count, Book Now/time, Reserve Now) and the right city and ticket parameters, but it uses 'event' where the true workflow uses date, folds city selection into the first step, and doesn't say how to pick the time/ticket option, so it would need minor clarification to automate.
